subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The patient was suffering from a __chronic__ disease.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Mild**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"chronic"** means something persisting for a long time or constantly recurring, especially in the context of a disease. (दीर्घकालीन)

 
 
• **Example: **He has been dealing with chronic back pain for years.
 
 
 
• **"Mild" **refers to something not severe, serious, or harsh. It is gentle in effect or degree. (हल्का)
 
 
• **Example: **He experienced mild symptoms of the flu, such as a slight fever and a sore throat.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 i.e. Mild**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Common **(सामान्य): Occurring, found, or done often; prevalent.

 
 
• **Example:** It is common for people to catch a cold during the winter months.
 
 
 
• **Universal **(सार्वभौमिक): Applicable to all cases; existing or true at all times or in all places.
 
 
• **Example: **The desire for love and acceptance is universal among humans.
 
 
 
• **Usual** (सामान्य): Habitually or typically occurring or done; customary.
 
 
• **Example:** She followed her usual routine of jogging and then having breakfast.
